Initial unconfirmed state; trigger 'quando consultada' is loose but observable.
Proposed validation lens; clearly status proposed and tied to Q5; no size list invented.
Restates source line 4 at behavior level; no gateway or amount invented.
Transition on gateway confirmation, supported by lines 4 and 5.
Stays unconfirmed while payment is not confirmed. Overlaps partly with AC2 but covers a different state (payment initiated).
Proposed; user notification wording is vague ('informado') with no message defined, consistent with Q3 pending. Acceptable as proposed, not as confirmed behavior.
Combines C4 and C3; unconfirmed excluded.

duplicates.rationale: AC2 covers a freshly registered entry before payment starts; AC6 covers waiting for gateway confirmation after payment is started. Overlapping outcome but different state and trigger.

Feature capability restates its only child story; acceptable hierarchy, optional simplification.

findings.actual: Tasks and the design cite criteria as AC-01..AC-11 with global numbering, while visible criterion IDs restart per story (CA-01..CA-04); e.g. T4 cites AC-04 but CA-04 under US2 is a different criterion (failure handling, proposed).
findings.expected: Cross-references from tasks to acceptance criteria use identifiers that a reader can resolve (visible IDs).
findings.impact: Implementers may verify the wrong criterion.
findings.recommendation: Reference criteria by stable global key or by story-qualified visible ID (US2/CA-01).
findings.why: Ambiguous references make traceability and later test mapping error-prone.

findings.actual: US1 benefit says 'garantir meu lugar no mutirao', which the source does not state and which contradicts the rule that only paid registrations are confirmed.
findings.expected: Story benefit follows the source: registration is only confirmed after payment.
findings.impact: Misleads stakeholders about what US1 delivers.
findings.recommendation: Rephrase the benefit as 'registrar meu interesse e seguir para o pagamento' or similar, without a place guarantee.
findings.why: Unsupported value claim in the story text.

findings.actual: Only T1 -> T7 is recorded; US3 has no edge to US2.
findings.expected: A sequencing relation from the story producing confirmed registrations (US2) to the list (US3), or an explicit note that none is needed.
findings.impact: Planning could schedule US3 without realistic data; may be intended since T1 supplies the status model.
findings.recommendation: Confirm whether US2 -> US3 sequencing is needed; add or justify.
findings.why: Confirmed registrants only exist after US2 flow.

findings.actual: T2 mentions 'ambiente de homologacao' and T4 a gateway test environment; AC1 mentions 'mutirao disponivel para inscricao'.
findings.expected: Verification steps reference only environments supported by the source.
findings.impact: Low; could set false expectations on environments and mutirao availability rules.
findings.recommendation: Use neutral wording ('ambiente de teste') and drop or question the availability notion.
findings.why: Mild invented context not present in the PRD; no technology, gateway, amount or threshold was invented.

findings.actual: Story text reads 'gostaria que me inscrever' / 'gostaria que pagar' / 'gostaria que ver' (infinitive after 'que').
findings.why: Template wording defect; meaning remains clear.

findings.actual: C5 left uncovered with open question Q4 and no performance criterion.
findings.expected: Non-measurable 'rapido' handled without inventing a threshold.
findings.impact: None; coverage of O5 stays QUESTION_REQUIRED until Q4 is answered.

independent_obligations.quote: O participante se inscreve em um mutirão informando nome e tamanho de camiseta.
independent_obligations.rationale: US1 and AC1 state the registration with name and size; mandatory-ness is not asserted by the source and is left to Q5/AC3 (proposed).
independent_obligations.text: Participant registers for a mutirao providing name and t-shirt size.

independent_obligations.quote: A taxa simbólica de inscrição é paga pelo gateway de pagamentos parceiro.
independent_obligations.rationale: Payment through the partner gateway is covered at behavior level; gateway identity, contract, fee amount and failure handling are unknown and correctly routed to SP1/Q1/Q2/Q3 without inventing any technology or value.
independent_obligations.text: The symbolic fee is paid through the partner payment gateway (gateway unidentified, no amount, no interface).

independent_obligations.quote: A inscrição só é confirmada após a confirmação do pagamento.
independent_obligations.rationale: Initial unconfirmed state, transition on confirmation, and staying unconfirmed otherwise are all verifiable.
independent_obligations.text: Registration is confirmed only after payment confirmation.

independent_obligations.quote: O organizador vê a lista de inscritos confirmados por mutirão.
independent_obligations.rationale: Confirmed-only, per-mutirao list covered; list content and access permission are open questions (Q6), not invented.
independent_obligations.text: The organizer sees the list of confirmed registrants per mutirao.

independent_obligations.rationale: No metric, operation or threshold in the source. Correctly left without a criterion and with an open question (Q4); no threshold invented.

items.notes: Epic outcome and scope match the PRD; out_scope on mutirao management is a reasonable boundary. 'confiavel' in the outcome is mildly subjective but harmless.
Groups registration, fee payment and confirmation rule; rules restate source lines 3-5 without additions.
Candidate sizing signal: the only child (US3) essentially restates the feature capability. Not a defect; optional merge or keep for hierarchy.
Justified spike for the unknown gateway contract (PRD names no gateway). Has question, decision output and follow-up links; no timebox supplied, none invented. Does not name any technology.

estimable.note: No team data; field obligation open in Q5.

independent.note: Must precede US2 (proposed predecessor edge exists, legitimate sequencing).

valuable.note: Benefit text overstates (guarantees a place); value is source-supported only as 'registers participation pending payment'.

items.notes: Benefit 'garantir meu lugar no mutirao' is not in the source and conflicts with the rule that registration is only confirmed after payment; a registration alone does not guarantee a place. Wording 'gostaria que me inscrever' is ungrammatical in the template.

estimable.note: Blocking Q1: gateway and contract unknown; estimating is not possible until SP1 or answer.

independent.note: Depends on US1 and on SP1 (blocking Q1); edges recorded.

negotiable.note: Gateway left to SP1, no technology imposed.

small.note: Cannot judge until contract is known.

testable.note: AC4 and AC5 are testable only at behavior level; failure handling AC7 is proposed and message undefined.

valuable.note: Benefit (confirmed registration) follows from source line 5.

items.notes: Blocked by Q1 (gateway unknown); title bundles pay and confirm, which are one indivisible flow so acceptable. Grammar 'gostaria que pagar'.

independent.note: Candidate: data of confirmed registrants originates in US2; no US2 -> US3 relation recorded (T1 -> T7 only).

items.notes: Clear actor and outcome; benefit 'saber quem participara' is a reasonable inference. No explicit dependency recorded on US2 although confirmed registrants only exist after US2 (candidate).

Depends on SP1 (relation recorded). Verification assumes a gateway test environment, not stated in source. Label AC-04 ambiguous because visible ID CA-04 belongs to a different story.
Directly implements C3 transition; covers non-confirmed returns generically. Depends on SP1. Label AC-05/AC-06 does not match visible IDs.

Implements C4; filter by mutirao and exclusion of unconfirmed. Labels AC-08..AC-10 are global keys, not visible IDs.
